title: Histological and histomorphometric evaluation of natural bovine bone substitute with hyaluronate in socket preservation — a report of three cases
studyType: Case report (three cases), histology and histomorphometry at 5 months
supports: Histological evidence of osteoconduction in socket preservation: granules in close contact with new cancellous bone, lamellar organisation, osteoblasts at the margins. Three cases only — the weakest clinical tier. Use it as illustration, never as proof of a population effect. Published data, cited in the botiss training decks and approved by botiss Medical Affairs.
